mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.0% signals weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) and housing starts (HOUST < 550) signals a broad-based economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95 and HOUST < 550, or Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 225), a persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 225 and FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS > 130,000) signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 130,000, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 550.0 thousand units (HOUST < 550.0) signals weak residential construction activity that depresses economic growth and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 550.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) signals monetary policy response to economic stagnation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% and UNRATE > 9.0%, or Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 95), a decline in manufacturing output signals reduced economic activity that lowers corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.05.
